events.title: Vince Giordano and the Nighthawks
events.details: In his Birdland Theater residency, GRAMMY Award winner, New York native, and multi-instrumentalist Vince Giordano leads The Nighthawks -- an 11-piece band who have set the standard for recreating authentic jazz sounds of the 1920s and beyond. In addition to club and concert appearances around the world, the band has provided period soundtracks for film and television productions including The Cotton Club, The Aviator, Finding Forrester, Revolutionary Road, Cafe Society, HBOs Boardwalk Empire, The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, the upcoming Martin Scorsese film Killers of The Flower Moon, and many more.

events.title: Phillip Officer Sings A Mabel Mercer Broadway Portfolio
events.details: BIRDLAND PRESENTS PHILLIP OFFICER SINGSA Mabel Mercer Broadway Portfolio Monday, October 26, 2026 at 7:00pm Special Guests: Tony Award winner ALICE RIPLEY, NATALIE DOUGLAS and MARIEANN MERINGOLO Acclaimed vocalist Phillip Officer celebrates the extraordinary artistry and enduring influence of legendary song stylist Mabel Mercer in A Mabel Mercer Broadway Portfolio, Monday, October 26 at 7pm at Birdland. Mercers impeccable diction, emotional honesty and devotion to the lyric influenced generations of great singers, including Frank Sinatra, Lena Horne, Tony Bennett, Bobby Short, Peggy Lee and Nat King Cole. Her repertoire embraced the finest Broadway songwriters of the 20th century, including Cole Porter, George and Ira Gershwin, Richard Rodgers and Oscar Hammerstein, and Cy Coleman and Carolyn Leigh. Officer brings that remarkable repertoire into the present, offering fresh interpretations of beloved standards and rarely heard gems, with an emphasis on storytelling rather than imitation. Joining him will be special guests Alice Ripley, Tony Award-winning star of Next to Normal; and acclaimed vocalists and recording artists Natalie Douglas and Marieann Meringolo.The evening features Mark Hartman as musical director, arranger and pianist, with Jonathan Michel on bass and Mollie Rose on violin. Phillip Officer has appeared on Broadway in the Tony Award-nominated musical Side Show, at Carnegie Hall, the Algonquin Hotels Oak Room, Birdland Jazz Club, Symphony Space, 92NY, Rainbow Yip Harburg, winner of a Bistro Award; Many a New Day: The Lyrics of Oscar Hammerstein II, praised by Billboard as a shining example of cabaret art; Heart and Soul: The Musical World of Hoagy Carmichael; and You Keep Coming Back Like a Song.

events.details: StorySLAM NYC-CARETAKERS. Prepare a 5-minute story about those who go the extra mile. Selfless moms & dutiful dads, family members who care for the young & old 24/7 or strangers & loved ones who step up in a pinch. Love, duty, blood, sweat & tears. The acts of service or obligation that are often invisible to everyone except those on the receiving end. The labor of care that is unpaid but priceless. The playlist that got you through a rough patch, the post-op meal train that kept you nourished. Did someone save the day w/ tough love or a couch to crash on? events.details: VIP experience includes: meet and greet and champagne TCB presents: CODE RED Code Red: Industry Night Weekly on Monday Doors 7:30pm Guest Opening Act 8pm Main Show featuring The Cabaret Burlesque 8:30 - 10:30pm Music and Bar until 1am Contact @thecabaretburlesque on instagram to APPLY to perform as an Opening Act An Industry Night where your wildest fantasies just might come true. Welcome to CODE RED---an electrifying world where Parisian cabaret meets Amsterdam's edge, Moscow's mystique, and the unapologetic glamour of Studio 54. Fashion is as much a part of the performance as the artists themselves, with striking couture, bold silhouettes, and runway-worthy style setting the scene for an unforgettable night. Expect dazzling performances, intoxicating music, provocative artistry, and immersive moments that blur the line between audience and spectacle. Inspired by the golden age of nightlife, where icons, artists, and dreamers came to see and be seen, CODE RED celebrates fearless self-expression, decadent entertainment, and the thrill of the unexpected. Dress boldly. Stay curious. Bring your calling card. Welcome to the show where fantasy, fashion, and nightlife collide.
